mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 drops > 1% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth expectations improve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as financial conditions ease.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS drops > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS rises > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS rises > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% year-over-year signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS rises > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and industrial production (INDPRO) is flat or declining, it signals a weakening supply-side and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops > 10% YoY and INDPRO flat or declining
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where HOUST drops > 10% YoY and INDPRO is flat or declining.
